Canadian canoeing uses a single-blade paddle to glide smoothly across the water in an active, dynamic way.

【Fee】3,000 yen per person (includes guide, insurance, and canoe rental)

【Capacity】5 people

【Guide】Staff from Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to bring】Towel, drinking water, and (if desired) sun protection such as hat or sunglasses. Life jackets are provided by the canoe workshop.

【More information】Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/

Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/naguricanoe-syokyu/
